paragraphs: DailyPay sells on-demand pay, a way for employees to reach wages they have already earned before the regular payday. The buyer is the employer, and the pitch is a benefit that helps with recruiting, retention, and engagement.

The service sits on top of an employer's existing payroll and is described as requiring little change to payroll processes. It connects to the human capital management, payroll, banking, and benefits applications a company already runs. Employees can reach up to 100% of their available earnings when an unexpected expense lands. Transfers and earned pay appear together in one app.

The company timeline records a launch in the United Kingdom. That same history lists a Series C round of $55 million. It has also launched DailyPay Tips, which gives workers access to their gratuities. The chief executive is described as having most recently served as chief financial officer of Uber.
